blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
A non-generative decision model scores candidate actions from their text and returns a temperature-scaled
probability, replacing a generation step with a single forward pass. The accurate way to do this reads the
state, the governing rules, and each candidate together —a joint scorer—so every candidate is
re-encoded against every state, and cost grows with the size of the candidate menu. Independent encoding
lets each candidate be encoded once and reused across states—a measured latency reduction that widens with
the menu (about 5 × 5\times at 77 77 candidates in our setup)—but it moves the state and the candidate apart. We ask how much rule-sensitivity —picking the action a
stated rule requires, not the one that merely looks similar—survives that move, and whether the loss can
be trained back. On Certo, a Qwen3-4B [ 1 ] decision model, we run four experiments. (1) At a
matched budget, the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity: a single-vector dual encoder
falls from 1.00 1.00 to 0.24 0.24 recall@1 on rule-sensitive selection while the joint scorer holds 1.00 1.00 ; a
shortlist-then-rerank rescue fails because the cheap encoder drops the compliant candidate before reranking. (2) Targeted supervision restores performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks —the cacheable encoder
reads paraphrased rules ( 0.99 0.99 – 1.00 1.00 ), tracks counterfactual flips ( 98.7 % 98.7\% of pairs correct on both sides
vs. 30 % 30\% ), composes operators, and partly handles rule types it never trained on, with every gain’s paired
interval excluding zero and the result reproducing across seeds; we do not isolate whether these predictions
depend on the supplied rule. (3) On real, human-authored
rules the added benefit is not established : after resolving a truncation confound that had masked the hard
tier, the joint scorer keeps a statistically significant edge on the short tier ( 0.861 0.861 vs. 0.500 0.500 ; paired
CI [ + 0.167 , + 0.556 ] [+0.167,+0.556] ) and a directional, non-significant one on the hard tier ( 0.655 0.655 vs. 0.483 0.483 , n = 29 n{=}29 ), while the synthetic recipe gives no convincing lift over the pre-trained encoder. (4) A
matched cross-domain real-prose mixture did not help and reduced unseen-source contract accuracy by 9.3 9.3 and 16.2 16.2 points ( − 0.093 -0.093 , 95% CI [ − 0.145 , − 0.039 ] [-0.145,-0.039] ; − 0.162 -0.162 , [ − 0.263 , − 0.062 ] [-0.263,-0.062] ), though the design confounds
reduced synthetic exposure with the added prose. The picture that holds up: targeted supervision restores strong
performance across held-out synthetic rule tasks, but we do not isolate whether it makes the encoder depend on
the supplied rule, and neither it nor a cross-domain real-prose mixture demonstrably improved unseen-source
real-rule decisions; the joint scorer keeps an advantage (significant on the short tier) at the cost of caching.
Beneficial transfer to unseen-source rules is not established ; the tested privacy-data replacement
produced a measured decline whose cause and generality remain unresolved.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Many production decisions are not open-ended generation. A support system routes a message to one of a fixed
set of intents; a workflow engine picks the one action a policy permits; a moderation layer answers a
yes/no question about a rule. For these, a large language model that writes a paragraph and then commits to
an answer is both slower than necessary and harder to calibrate than a model that simply scores the options.
blocks.zh:
许多生产决策不是不限成员名额的一代。 支持系统将消息传递给固定的
一套意图; 一个工作流程引擎选择一个政策允许的行动; 温和层回答 a
是/没有关于规则的问题。 对于这些,一个写一个段落,然后承诺
答案既比必要的要慢,也比简单的评分选项的模型更难校准。

blocks.en:
Certo is a small, non-generative decision model built for this shape of problem. It encodes a state —the situation together with the rules that govern it—and scores each candidate action from
its text, returning a temperature-scaled probability over the candidates for three primitives: Choice (pick one of several), Score (an ordinal level), and Noul (yes/no). One forward pass, no
generation, probabilities as the primary output.
blocks.zh:
Certo是一个小的,非遗传性的决策模式,为这种问题形状而建立. 它编码了一个州——情况及其规则——并给每个候选人的行动评分。
其文字,返回三个原始人候选人的温度级概率: 选择(从几个中选一个)、得分(正数级)和努尔(是/否)。 一个前传,没有
生成,概率作为主输出.

blocks.en:
The reference model uses a joint scorer: the state, the rules, and one candidate are read together in
a single sequence, and a head emits a relevance score. Reading them together is what lets the model apply a
rule to a candidate. It is also what makes the model expensive at scale: because a candidate only ever
exists fused with a state, its representation cannot be reused, and the cost of scoring a menu grows with the
number of candidates. Serving stacks already reuse computation in a limited way: automatic prefix
caching [ 2 ] lets a causal joint scorer reuse the shared state-and-rules prefix across the
candidates of a single state, so only each candidate’s suffix is recomputed. What no joint scorer can
do is reuse a candidate’s representation across different states, because that representation is always
conditioned on the state it was scored against.
blocks.zh:
参考模式使用联合计分器:状态,规则,一名候选人一起阅读
一个序列,一个头发出一个相关的分数。 一起看就是让模型应用
规则给候选人。 这也是使得模型在规模上变得昂贵的原因:因为只有一名候选人曾经

blocks.en:
The alternative is independent encoding , the design behind dense retrieval [ 3 , 4 ] and its
multi-vector variants [ 5 ] : encode the state once and each candidate once, then combine cheaply.
This adds the second kind of reuse—a candidate’s vector is state-independent, so it is computed once and
reused across every state that shares a rubric. In our measurements this widens the latency gap with menu
size (§ 3 ); we report it for the implementation measured, not as an architectural constant. The
risk is equally real: the state and the candidate never meet inside the network, and rule application may be
exactly the interaction that separation destroys.

多变量变体 [5]:将状态编码一次,每个候选者一次,然后廉价结合.

blocks.en: This paper is a study of that tradeoff on one model. The precise question is:
blocks.zh: 本文是对一种模式的权衡研究。 确切的问题是:

blocks.en:
How much rule-sensitivity survives when a joint decision scorer is converted to a cacheable
independent-encoding scorer, can the loss be trained back, and does any recovered rule-sensitivity transfer
to real rules the model was not trained on?
blocks.zh:
当联合决定计分器转换为缓存器时,规则敏感性还能维持多久
独立编码计分员,可以重新训练损失,并进行任何恢复的规则敏感性转移
对真正的规则 该模型没有训练?

blocks.en:
Our contributions are four experiments and a qualified answer. Section 3 shows the conversion
loses rule-sensitivity and a shortlist rescue fails. Section 4 shows counterfactual supervision
recovers it on synthetic rules, reproducibly. Section 5 tests real rules, uncovers and resolves
a truncation confound, and finds the synthetic recovery does not clearly transfer. Section 6 runs a controlled real-prose training pilot and finds cross-domain data does not help. We are explicit
throughout about which claims are established and which are not.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献是四项实验和合格的答案。 第3节显示转换情况
失去对规则的敏感度 和短名单救援失败。 第4节显示反事实监督
以合成规则回收,可复制. 第五节 检验实际规则、发现和解决
发现合成回收没有明显转移。 第6节运行一个受控的实证训练飞行员,发现跨域数据没有帮助. 我们很清楚
用来证明哪些权利要求成立,哪些权利要求无效。

2 Setting and architectures
blocks.zh: 2 设置和结构

blocks.en:
Certo is a Qwen3-4B [ 1 ] encoder. All scorers share the backbone’s causal
attention and differ in how hidden states are reduced to a score (below). Choice and Noul are trained with a multiclass Brier loss [ 6 ] ; Score with a ranked-probability (squared-EMD)
loss [ 7 ] . Outputs are temperature-scaled per primitive [ 8 ] ; we do not measure
calibration under transfer, so we describe them as temperature-scaled probabilities rather than calibrated
ones. Adapters are LoRA [ 9 ] (rank 16 16 ) on the attention and MLP projections.

这些 适配器是关注和MLP预测的LORA [9](排名16 16).

where the state and a candidate meet, which decides whether a candidate’s representation is reusable. • A pair A_{\text{pair}} (joint cross-encoder). Each candidate is concatenated with the state and rules into

State and each candidate are encoded separately; each one’s

The joint scorer nails rule-sensitivity ( 1.00 1.00 ) but its latency grows with the menu (Figure 3 ).
The single-vector encoder keeps partial routing but loses rule-sensitivity ( 0.24 0.24 – 0.54 0.54 vs. 1.00 1.00 ); the

the candidate count, but is negligible here). The measured latency gap is about 2.9 × 2.9\times at K20 ( 135 135 vs. 46 46 ms) and 5.3 × 5.3\times at K77 ( 242 242 vs. 46 46 ms), the largest menu we measure, and widens with K K ;
these are execution latencies, not scoring-pass counts (Figure 3 ).

We tried a hybrid: retrieve a cheap top- k k with the cacheable
encoder, then rerank with the joint scorer. The target is candidate-inclusion recall@ k k —the rule-compliant
answer appearing in the top- k k —at ≥ 0.98 \geq 0.98 , so a compute-saving k k (smaller than the menu) still leaves
the reranker a correct option to pick. The rule-sensitive slice has 17 17 candidates (the K17
column of Table 1 ). At the tested shortlist sizes, inclusion recall was 0.72 0.72 / 0.80 0.80 at k = 5 k{=}5 / 10 10 and reached 1.00 1.00 only at k = 17 k{=}17 , i.e. the full set (no shortlist); k = 11 k{=}11 – 16 16 were not
measured. On routing, inclusion recall was 0.70 0.70 / 0.82 0.82 / 0.93 0.93 at k = 5 k{=}5 / 10 10 / 20 20 and hybrid top-1 accuracy
( 0.57 0.57 – 0.64 0.64 ) did not exceed the joint reranker’s 0.65 0.65 . So for the tested reduced shortlists, no size both
saved compute and met the target. The omitted candidates were the rule-compliant ones, which is consistent with
surface-similarity ranking but does not by itself establish that as the cause. Among the conversions

blocks.en: 4 Experiment 2: counterfactual supervision recovers it on synthetic rules

blocks.en:
Rather than change the architecture, we changed the data. The single-vector encoder (B) was continued on counterfactual rule pairs: two situations that differ by exactly one condition—an exception firing,
a threshold crossed—so the correct action flips. The rule is written into the state, keeping candidates
cacheable, and the semantically tempting but prohibited action is always present as a hard
negative [ 11 ] . Positives are labelled by an executable rule.

一个阈值,所以正确的动作是翻转的。 规则是写进州里,保留候选人
可缓存的 诱人但被禁止的行动 总是有困难
负 [11]. 阳性被可执行规则贴上标签.

The treatment reads paraphrased rules it never saw, answers both sides of a counterfactual pair correctly 98.7 % 98.7\% of the time against 30 % 30\% for the baseline, composes operators, and partly handles rule types

primary test was a source-disjoint corpus—contract questions ( consumer_contracts_qa and contract_qa )—never seen in training. We report inputs that fit the trained window separately from
those that do not, per an input-validity check. Results are in Table 4 and
Figure 6 .

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The four experiments compose into a single, qualified reading. A cacheable independent-encoding decision model generalizes across held-out variants of its training distribution (paraphrase, counterfactual,
composition, a second seed); whether it does so by interpreting the supplied rule, rather than a learned
decision pattern, is what the rule-only control would settle, and we do not claim it here. What did not hold is
transfer: neither the synthetic recipe (Experiment 3) nor a cross-domain real-prose mixture (Experiment 4)
demonstrably improved decisions on unseen-source real rules. Meanwhile the joint scorer wins significantly on
the short real-rule slice (the hard-tier edge is uncertain), and pays for it with candidate recomputation.
blocks.zh:
四个实验组成一个单一的,合格的阅读. 一种可缓存的独立编码决定模式概括了其培训分布的被搁置的变体(短语,反事实,
(b) 是否通过解释所提供规则,而不是通过学习来这样做;
裁决模式,是只由规则控制才能解决的,我们在此不主张. 根本就没有
转让:既不是合成食谱(试验3),也不是跨域真假混合物(试验4)
明显改进了对无源实际规则的决定。 同时联赛得分大赢
短的实规则片(硬层边缘不确定),用候选人的重评来支付.

blocks.en:
The result is an application-dependent tradeoff, not a general
recommendation. Where menus are small and rule-sensitivity matters, the joint scorer is the safer choice; we
report its latency (Table 1 ) and leave the affordability judgment to the application. Where menus are
large, the cacheable encoder’s serving advantage is real, but so is its accuracy cost even on
routing— 0.422 0.422 vs. 0.652 0.652 for the joint scorer at K77—so the choice depends on how much accuracy the
application can trade for latency. A promising but untested hypothesis is that training on the customer’s own
decision types is what makes Certo strong; we did not demonstrate this on a customer dataset or a source-matched
real-rule experiment, and we did not establish that either scorer generalizes to unseen-source rules for free.
blocks.zh:
结果是一种依赖应用的权衡,而不是一般的
建议。 菜单小而且对规则敏感的地方,联合计分员是更安全的选择;
(c) 报告其延迟性(表1),并将可负担性判断留给申请。 菜单在哪里
大型,可缓存编码器的服务优势是真实的,但准确性成本甚至是
路线——K77联合计分器0.422 0.422对0.652 0.652——因此,选择取决于该机的精确度。
应用程序可以交换延迟。 一个有希望但未经检验的假设是,由客户自己培训
决策类型是Certo的强项;我们没有在客户数据集或源匹配的数据集上证明这一点
而我们并没有确定 任何一位评分员 都会免费使用无源规则

blocks.en:
Experiment 3 is a reminder that an evaluation window is part of the model.
The hard-tier “null” was an artifact of appending the candidate after a long document and truncating from
the right; the fix was an input audit and a within-window rescore, not more training. Reporting fitting and
truncated inputs separately is cheap insurance against this class of confound.
blocks.zh:
实验3提醒大家,评价窗口是模型的一部分.
硬派的“null”是一份长文件之后附赠候选人的一件艺术品,从中切除。
(d) 补救是投入审计和窗口内部的复数,而不是更多的培训。 报告
分开截断的投入是针对这种混乱的廉价保险。

blocks.en: 8 Future work
blocks.zh: 第8条 今后的工作

blocks.en:
Several experiments would sharpen or overturn the negative-transfer reading, roughly in order of expected
value.
blocks.zh:
几项实验可以使负转移读数变精或翻转,大致按预期的顺序排列。
数值。

blocks.en:
1. Rule-only counterfactual test. The decisive control for rule use: hold the facts and
candidates fixed and change only the stated rule so the correct answer moves, with deleted-rule and
shuffled-rule baselines. This would separate genuine rule application from a learned, template-specific
procedure, which the current condition-flipping pairs do not fully isolate. 2. A third pilot arm. To separate reduced synthetic exposure from added privacy prose in
Experiment 4, add an arm with the same reduced synthetic count and no privacy supervision. 3. Choice-format real rules. Experiments 3–4 lean on binary and short-clause real tasks; the
joint-vs-cacheable gap is clearest on multi-candidate Choice . A real, multi-candidate rule corpus
(for example contract-clause selection or statutory reasoning framed as choice) would test the gap where
it matters most. 4. A prefix-reusing joint latency baseline. Our latency comparison is against a joint scorer
without prefix caching. A joint scorer that reuses the shared state prefix across candidates would narrow the
gap; measuring it would scope the caching advantage precisely. 5. Source-matched training. The pilot trained on privacy policies and tested on contracts. A
matched pilot—train and test on the same document family, split by document—would separate “real prose
does not help” from “cross-domain real prose does not help.” 6. A joint model on the same new data. To attribute the remaining real-rule gap specifically to
architecture, the joint scorer should be trained on the same real corpus as the cacheable one; only then is
the comparison an architecture comparison rather than a data comparison. 7. Longer windows and centre-preserving truncation. The joint scorer’s real-rule ceiling is
entangled with context length. Training and serving at longer windows, and truncating the state rather than
the appended candidate, would remove the confound of Experiment 3 by construction. 8. The multi-vector collapse. C’s failure was observed as a MaxSim score collapse but its
mechanism (long causal state swamping late interaction) is proposed, not isolated; a length/mask/aggregation
ablation would settle it, and a rule-aware multi-vector encoder may recover more than the single-vector one. 9. The precedence ceiling. Recall@1 on the untrained precedence rule type tops out at 0.73 0.73 on
both seeds; targeted supervision for ordered-rule application is the obvious next lever. 10. Calibration under transfer. We report accuracy under transfer but not calibration; whether a
rule-aware cacheable encoder stays calibrated on unseen-source rules is a separate, deployment-relevant
question.
blocks.zh:
一、导 言 只有规则的反事实测试。 规则使用方面的决定性控制:掌握事实
候选人只固定并修改了声明的规则,所以正确的答案移动,删除规则和
洗动规则基线。 这将将真正的规则应用与有经验、有模板针对性的
程序,即当前条件浸泡对不完全隔离的程序。 2. 第三个试验臂。 将减少的合成接触与增加的隐私传言区分开来。
实验4,增加一个手臂,同样减少合成计数,没有隐私监督. 3. 选择格式的实际规则。 实验3 - 4 依赖于二进制和短写的实际任务;
在多个指定日期中,可交接的连接空档最明显 选择. 一个真实的,多功能的规则
(例如,合同条款的选择或法定推理被确定为选择)将检验空白之处。
这很重要。 4. 使用前缀的联合延迟基线。 我们的潜伏比喻是联合计分员
不设前缀 一个联合计分器在候选人之间重复使用共享状态前缀将缩小
差距;测量差距将精确地涵盖缓存优势。 5. 来源匹配的培训。 该试点对隐私政策进行了培训,并对合同进行了测试。 页:1

架构中,联合计分器应当与可缓存器相同的真实体;
比较结构比较而不是数据比较。 7. 较长的窗口和中央保留截断。 联合计分员的实际上限是

问.

blocks.en:
Rule-only counterfactual test. The decisive control for rule use: hold the facts and
candidates fixed and change only the stated rule so the correct answer moves, with deleted-rule and
shuffled-rule baselines. This would separate genuine rule application from a learned, template-specific
procedure, which the current condition-flipping pairs do not fully isolate.
blocks.zh:
只有规则的反事实测试。 规则使用方面的决定性控制:掌握事实
候选人只固定并修改了声明的规则,所以正确的答案移动,删除规则和
洗动规则基线。 这将将真正的规则应用与有经验、有模板针对性的
程序,即当前条件浸泡对不完全隔离的程序。

blocks.en:
A third pilot arm. To separate reduced synthetic exposure from added privacy prose in
Experiment 4, add an arm with the same reduced synthetic count and no privacy supervision.
blocks.zh:
第三个飞行员手臂。 将减少的合成接触与增加的隐私传言区分开来。
实验4,增加一个手臂,同样减少合成计数,没有隐私监督.

blocks.en:
Choice-format real rules. Experiments 3–4 lean on binary and short-clause real tasks; the
joint-vs-cacheable gap is clearest on multi-candidate Choice . A real, multi-candidate rule corpus
(for example contract-clause selection or statutory reasoning framed as choice) would test the gap where
it matters most.
blocks.zh:
选择格式真实规则。 实验3 - 4 依赖于二进制和短写的实际任务;
在多个指定日期中,可交接的连接空档最明显 选择. 一个真实的,多功能的规则
(例如,合同条款的选择或法定推理被确定为选择)将检验空白之处。
这很重要。

blocks.en:
A prefix-reusing joint latency baseline. Our latency comparison is against a joint scorer
without prefix caching. A joint scorer that reuses the shared state prefix across candidates would narrow the
gap; measuring it would scope the caching advantage precisely.
blocks.zh:
使用前缀的联动延迟基线. 我们的潜伏比喻是联合计分员
不设前缀 一个联合计分器在候选人之间重复使用共享状态前缀将缩小
差距;测量差距将精确地涵盖缓存优势。

blocks.en:
Source-matched training. The pilot trained on privacy policies and tested on contracts. A
matched pilot—train and test on the same document family, split by document—would separate “real prose
does not help” from “cross-domain real prose does not help.”
blocks.zh:
来源匹配的培训。 该试点对隐私政策进行了培训,并对合同进行了测试。 页:1
将 " 真正的传教士 " 分开。
“跨领域真正的传言没有帮助”。 “

blocks.en:
A joint model on the same new data. To attribute the remaining real-rule gap specifically to
architecture, the joint scorer should be trained on the same real corpus as the cacheable one; only then is
the comparison an architecture comparison rather than a data comparison.

Longer windows and centre-preserving truncation. The joint scorer’s real-rule ceiling is
entangled with context length. Training and serving at longer windows, and truncating the state rather than
the appended candidate, would remove the confound of Experiment 3 by construction.
blocks.zh:
更长的窗口和中保持截断。 联合计分员的实际上限是
与上下文长度缠绕. 培训和在更长的窗口中服务,并缩短国家,而不是
随附的候选者,将通过施工来消除实验3的混乱.

blocks.en:
The multi-vector collapse. C’s failure was observed as a MaxSim score collapse but its
mechanism (long causal state swamping late interaction) is proposed, not isolated; a length/mask/aggregation
ablation would settle it, and a rule-aware multi-vector encoder may recover more than the single-vector one.
blocks.zh:
多脉者崩. C的失败被观察到是马克思辛的分数崩溃,但是它
建议建立机制(长时间的因果状态,导致晚期互动); 长度/任务/汇总
膨胀会解决它,规则意识的多载体编码器可能比单载体编码器恢复得更多.

blocks.en:
The precedence ceiling. Recall@1 on the untrained precedence rule type tops out at 0.73 0.73 on
both seeds; targeted supervision for ordered-rule application is the obvious next lever.
blocks.zh:
优先的上限。 提醒@ 1 未经过训练的优先规则类型在 0. 73 0. 73 上
这两种种子;有针对性地监督命令规则的适用显然是下一个杠杆。

blocks.en:
Calibration under transfer. We report accuracy under transfer but not calibration; whether a
rule-aware cacheable encoder stays calibrated on unseen-source rules is a separate, deployment-relevant
question.
9 Limitations
blocks.zh: 9 限制

blocks.en:
The real-rule evaluations are small (tens of items per slice) with wide intervals, and most are binary or
short-clause; the joint-vs-cacheable choice gap rests on the JevBench choice slices. The rule-aware result
establishes generalization across held-out synthetic rule tasks, not that predictions depend on the supplied
rule; the rule-only control that would isolate this (§ 8 ) is not yet run. The real-prose pilot
is a single source pairing and a single seed;
a different pairing or a choice-format corpus could differ. C’s collapse mechanism is proposed, not isolated.
Attributing the real-rule gap specifically to architecture, rather than to data, would require the joint
model trained on the same new corpus, which we did not run. All results are on one backbone (Qwen3-4B) and
one adapter recipe.
blocks.zh:
实际规则评价是小(每片10件),间隔很广,大多数是二进制评价或
short-clause; 联合-vs-可切换选择空白在于 Jev Bench 选择切片。 了解规则的结果
确定对被搁置的合成规则任务的概括,而不是预测取决于所提供的
规则;将此(§8)隔离的仅规则控制尚未运行。 真正的宣传飞行员
是一个单一的配对和单一的种子;
不同的配对法或选择格式法可能有所不同。 C的崩溃机制是提出来的,而不是孤立的.
将实际规则差距具体归因于结构而不是数据,就需要联合
模型训练了相同的新体格, 我们没有运行。 所有结果都集中在一个支柱(Quen3-4B)和
一个适配方。

blocks.en: 10 Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 10 可复制性

blocks.en:
All experiments run on NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs (four for training, one for the
latency measurements). Adapters are LoRA (rank 16 16 , α = 32 \alpha{=}32 ) on the q,k,v,o,gate,up,down projections, AdamW at learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} (cosine, 100 100 warmup steps), bf16, gradient
checkpointing. Experiment 1 trains all four arms for 1000 1000 steps from the same reference model with
effective batch 64 64 (matched budget): the dual arm at state length 640 640 , candidate length 64 64 , projection 512 512 (per-device batch 8 8 , accumulation 2 2 ); the joint cross-encoder A pair A_{\text{pair}} at sequence length 704 704 (per-device batch 4 4 , accumulation 4 4 ); the multi-vector arm at state length 512 512 , candidate length 48 48 ,
projection 128 128 ; A 10 A_{10} is the native joint head of the reference model. Experiment 2 continues the
dual arm for 600 600 steps (control on a neutral mixture, treatment on the counterfactual mixture; both from the
Experiment 1 dual checkpoint), and Experiment 4 for 500 500 steps, each with the same optimizer settings.
Checkpoints for the cacheable arms are on Hugging Face ( rajpdus/certo-rule-aware-arms ). The scripts for
all four experiments, the frozen generalization suite, the locked real-prose test set, and per-item prediction
files—from which every reported interval can be recomputed without retraining—are released at https://github.com/AltSlate-Labs/certo-rules-or-reuse (tag v1.0 , commit c0c0472 ). Every
real-rule and pilot evaluation reports inputs that fit the trained window separately from those that do not;
treatment-vs-control differences are bootstraps grouped by the unit of dependence (§ 2 ).
